scripture.verse: So run, that ye may obtain.
Yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

sermons.title: Sermon 200 | The Wicked Man's Life, Funeral, and Epitaph

scripture.verse: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.

sermons.title: Sermon 201 | The Outpouring of the Holy Spirit

scripture.verse: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the Word

sermons.title: Sermon 202 | The Conversion of Saul of Tarsus

scripture.verse: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

sermons.title: Sermon 203 | The Sympathy of the Two Worlds

scripture.verse: There is joy in the: presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

sermons.title: Sermon 204 | The Mission of the Son of Man

scripture.verse: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of everyone of you all toward each other aboundeth
I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes.
